serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: Hi Anon. How are you?
You: Good I guess? Why are four of you this time around? And I don’t remember telling you my name…
Policewoman: Don’t worry about these things Anon, we are your friends here, no matter what happens next. Just, stay calm and let us do our work, ok?
You: W-what? Am I in trouble?
Policewoman: Sir, you are under arrest. You are suspected of being in possession of an unregistered automaton and being in possession of a sexbot. 
T-they know! I-I need to run!
Policeman: He moved! He wants to get away!
